build_ldm_vae: build a python module that creates an LDM variational autoencoder with configurable channels and res blocks
test_encode_vae: test the VAE encode method to verify posterior mean and stddev shapes and values
test_decode_vae: test the VAE decode method to verify output tensor shape and expected sum values
test_forward_vae: test the VAE forward pass with and without posterior sampling to verify decoder output
test_kl_divergence_vae: test the KL divergence between the VAE posterior and a standard normal distribution
